name: Barnard's Star
what_it_is: a red dwarf star (spectral type M4 V), one of the closest stars to the Sun

motion.how_measured: position measured in each WISE image, then a straight-line fit through time

notes: Saturated in 356 of 357 images (OVERFLOW flag or empty core): too bright for SPHEREx, so no spectrum of the star itself is shown.

what_to_look_for_in_the_movie: the bright star slides upward (north) by about 146 arcseconds between 2010 and 2024
